summary: Iteration 4 (Playdate RSVP Queue + Family Chat Requests) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (test_iteration4.py): 18/19 PASS (1 non-bug stateful failure from prior-run persisted thread — covered by separate test_duplicate_returns_exists which passes). Verified: (a) POST /api/playdates/{id}/join now returns status='requested' with a pending join_request (no auto-add), 2nd call returns 'already_pending', host gets 400; (b) GET /api/playdates/{id}/requests: host sees pending list with family+match_score+match_reasons, non-host 403; (c) POST .../approve adds user to attendee_family_ids and marks request approved; (d) POST .../decline sets declined without adding attendee; (e) GET /api/playdates/{id} returns request_status ('none'|'pending'|'approved'|'declined'|'host'), is_host and pending_requests_count for host; (f) POST /api/threads/request creates status='requested' thread with opening_message as first message and initiator_id=me; duplicate returns status='exists' with same thread_id; (g) POST /api/threads/{id}/messages returns 400 when status='requested'; (h) POST accept flips to active only for recipient (initiator 400) and unlocks send; (i) POST decline sets declined only for recipient; (j) GET /api/threads adds status+is_initiator on each and seeded threads default to active. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport) verified: sign-in works, /playdate/pd-soccer shows playdate-join with 'Waiting for host…' mustard label (demo has pending request), /family/fam-emma family-say-hi opens modal with 3 chat-opener-* presets + chat-request-input textarea + chat-request-send + Cancel; sending navigates to /messages/{id} where chat-outgoing-pending banner shows and input is disabled ('Waiting for accept…' placeholder); Messages list shows 'Pending' and 'Declined' tags on relevant rows; Host-view of a demo-created playdate renders playdate-host-requests section with 'JOIN REQUESTS (n)' header, req-* rows with test_u_* family display+match_score, req-approve-* + req-decline-* icon buttons; approving moves user into attendee_family_ids and reduces pending_requests_count to 0 (verified via API). Regression: seeded th-sarah thread still accepts POST /messages, block/unblock still works, POST /api/playdates still creates.

minor.issue: If demo user re-uses same target across test runs, returns 'exists' with the FIRST opening_message rather than the new one — this is by-design (opening_message is only used when creating). Documented for test writers; not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Repeats in console across cards/buttons (carried over from iteration 3). Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/playdate-card.tsx and other components using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Carryover) server.py is now ~1020 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/playdates/threads/safety/seed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py join_playdate correctly no longer auto-adds attendee — creates pending join_request and returns 'requested'/'already_pending'/'already_joined' (server.py:347-368).
list_playdate_requests decorates each request with family + match_details() output — good; 403 enforced for non-host (server.py:371-386).
approve_request uses $addToSet on attendee_family_ids (idempotent) and short-circuits if already decided (server.py:393-409).
get_playdate returns clean request_status semantics — 'host'|'approved'|'pending'|'declined'|'none' — including pending_requests_count only for host (server.py:327-339).
request_chat correctly dedupes by (family_id, initiator_id) to avoid duplicate threads (server.py:650). Good.
send_message correctly returns 400 for both 'requested' and 'declined' statuses (server.py:624-627).
accept_chat/decline_chat correctly disallow the initiator from either action (server.py:677-678, 688-689).
list_threads sets is_initiator per-caller and sorts incoming-requests first — good UX.
GET /api/threads/{id} uses setdefault for legacy threads — safe migration for seeded data.
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event still used (noted in prior iterations).

rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs. The 1 backend test failure (test_create_thread_request) is a test-side artifact: because Mongo persists threads across pytest runs and the endpoint intentionally returns the existing thread on duplicate (target, initiator) pair, the opening_message assertion fails when the thread already exists from a previous run. The 'exists' code path is verified separately by test_duplicate_returns_exists which passes. To make the test self-cleaning, either delete threads for the demo user in a fixture or use a unique target_family_id per run.
